title: Copilot draft hand-off: copilot-agent.yml publishes, copilot-review.yml consumes ready_for_review; change both together
answers: how does a Copilot draft PR get marked ready and then reviewed
which workflow handles Copilot review_requested on draft PRs
why did copilot-review.yml stop listening to review_requested
change the Copilot review trigger types
body:
Invariant: draft publication lives only in copilot-agent.yml (`publish-draft`, triggered by pull_request_target review_requested, guarded to draft==true and Copilot Bot author). The review request lives in copilot-review.yml (`request-review`, triggered by opened and ready_for_review, guarded to draft==false).
The hand-off is the `ready_for_review` event that publish-draft emits. copilot-review.yml's types list and its draft==false guard must stay compatible with it.
Do not re-add review_requested to copilot-review.yml's types or move draft handling back there: the PR removed both the trigger and the draft-publish step from that file.
Skipping this breaks the chain: the PR stays draft and the review is never requested.
applies: Any change to triggers, if-guards, or draft handling of the Copilot automation workflows in .github/workflows.
says: The automated assistant pull request remains in draft and never receives an automated review.
Draft pull requests created by Copilot fail to publish and request code review comments.
Requesting a review on a draft pull request does not mark it ready for reviewers.
Automatically publish draft pull requests and assign the bot reviewer when review is requested.
The bot never reviews draft pull requests after asking for review feedback.
search: Copilot draft publication and review requests are split across .github/workflows/copilot-agent.yml and .github/workflows/copilot-review.yml and must be modified together. Draft publication is handled exclusively by copilot-agent.yml:publish-draft on pull_request_target review_requested when draft is true and authored by Copilot Bot. Review requests are handled by copilot-review.yml:request-review on opened and ready_for_review events when draft is false, consuming the ready_for_review event emitted by draft publication. Do not re-add review_requested or draft-publishing steps to copilot-review.yml, as breaking this event chain leaves pull requests in draft without requesting reviews.
